Package com.sca4d.app.server.service

Class PlatformAuthenticationPolicyService

java.lang.Object
com.sca4d.app.server.service.PlatformAuthenticationPolicyService
All Implemented Interfaces:
com.sca4d.core.api.authentication.AuthenticationPolicy
@Service public class PlatformAuthenticationPolicyService extends Object implements com.sca4d.core.api.authentication.AuthenticationPolicy
实现 Sca4d Server 的登录和敏感动作认证规则，并管理账号的方法开关。
